best_configuration.name: hybrid-rerank
best_configuration.reason: Highest MRR and nDCG among evaluated configurations. Hybrid-rerank-dedupe achieved the same ranking quality with lower latency in this single run.

notes: All configurations achieved perfect Recall@K on the current evaluation set.
Sparse retrieval outperformed dense retrieval on ranking quality.
Reranking produced the strongest MRR and nDCG scores.
The current benchmark uses a small, terminology-heavy dataset based on a single technical document.
Latency values are from a single run and should not be treated as stable performance measurements.
